summary: Phase 1 Code Hygiene: Added from __future__ import annotations and module-level loggers to courier/config.py and courier/__main__.py. Renamed _filter_articles to filter_articles in courier/orchestrator.py and updated all references in tests/test_orchestrator.py. All 19 targeted tests pass.

patternsFollowed.notes: Applied to config.py and __main__.py: from __future__ import annotations as first import, import logging in stdlib block, logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) after all imports before first class/function.

patternsFollowed.patternName: Private helper functions with underscore prefix
patternsFollowed.notes: Removed underscore from _filter_articles since it has a stable, tested contract and is directly imported by tests. Now public as filter_articles.

implementedFeatures.featureName: Add future annotations and logger to config.py
implementedFeatures.description: Added from __future__ import annotations as first import, import logging to stdlib imports, and logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) after all imports before the Config dataclass.
implementedFeatures.notes: config.py did not previously have from __future__ import annotations or a logger.

implementedFeatures.featureName: Add future annotations and logger to __main__.py
implementedFeatures.description: Added from __future__ import annotations as first import and logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) after all imports before the main() function. import logging was already present.
implementedFeatures.notes: __main__.py already had import logging; only added future annotations and logger instance.

implementedFeatures.description: Renamed the function definition from _filter_articles to filter_articles in orchestrator.py (definition and call site). Updated the import and all usages in tests/test_orchestrator.py.
implementedFeatures.patternUsed: Private helper functions with underscore prefix (Pattern 3)
implementedFeatures.notes: Function renamed to public because it has a stable, tested contract. Updated 2 references in orchestrator.py (definition + call site) and 8 references in test_orchestrator.py (import + 7 usages).

nextSteps: Phase 1 Testing: Verify logger presence in config and __main__ modules, run regression suite
Phase 2 Implementation: CLI error handling, print-to-logger, cache wiring, Jinja2 env, config validation, trust comment
additionalNotes: All 19 targeted tests (3 smoke + 16 orchestrator) pass with zero failures. No other code references to _filter_articles exist outside of documentation/plan files which are out of scope.
